changes: Normalize acyclic local root $defs references before root/strict validation, native grammar construction, prompt projection and emitted-value validation.
Decode URI fragment percent encoding and JSON Pointer escapes. Reject missing, external, recursive, resource-scoped and Draft 7 references.
Preserve reducible allOf and $ref-sibling intersections; reject conflicting keys, object property scope merges and union/assertion intersections.
Validate $comment/deprecated/readOnly/writeOnly annotations. Do not interpret literal values as schemas.
Apply both source/expanded depth and node budgets, plus a bounded normalization visit count.
Resolve namespace child references in the child document before embedding into a Responses dispatcher.
Filter native string constants against all conjuncts so enum/const/length intersections match emitted-value checks.

official_suite.selection_boundary: Only groups fitting the normalized bounded subset. Not a complete official suite or full dialect conformance.

regressions: All six native tool dialects accept valid referenced numeric arguments and reject values outside either allOf bound in both grammar and parser.
Structured output token constraints and value validation agree on positive/negative bounds, types, required and additional properties.
Native string terminals preserve enum, const and length intersections.
Escaped pointers, chained references, schema-looking literal data, strict rules, resource/recursive references, malformed annotations and expansion budgets.
OpenCode captured request plus synthetic referenced plugin tool prepares consistent model/wire schemas without mutating client request.
Responses namespace resolves root references before changing schema scope.
remaining_limits: No full Draft 2020-12 conformance claim. Only the documented schema subset is accepted.
Only acyclic direct references to root $defs entries. No nested $defs, arbitrary document pointers, external/file references, $id, anchors, $dynamicRef or $vocabulary.
No general allOf, overlapping oneOf, boolean schemas, conditionals or unevaluatedProperties.
No fresh real App/OpenCode Desktop/AFT full-plugin or model-backed end-to-end acceptance in this change.
No CI monitoring, merge or push performed for this follow-up.

server_all_features.ignored_boundary: Existing tests requiring separately provisioned models/backends; these were not treated as passes.

conformance_assessment.finding: Full official core scan found nine semantic validator mismatches within admitted schemas. The earlier 11 selected instances are insufficient for a readiness claim.

record_scope: Historical pre-numeric-fix evidence; see numeric_semantics_followup for the subsequent source state and test results.
